# Order-free FUSE (generated by scripts/run_fuse_order_free.py)

AUC. 'Random order' = mean over 4 random column orders of the same panel. Order-free FUSE = FUSE(tci_symmetric=True, tci_search='greedy'), which gives the same result in any order. ± = 95% over draws (the best baseline is chosen after the fact, which favours the baselines).

## 1. Simulation (10 seeds, 1000 items, 30% positive)

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

| 5 humans + 6 LLMs (d=0.3), shared noise 0.15 | 88.3 | 88.5 | **88.5** | 87.9 | 88.1 | 89.0 | 87.9 | -0.5 ± 3.0 (D&S -> logistic) | +0.6 ± 2.7 |
